This clears the count for all 40 days and starts a fresh cycle. This cannot be undone. Exported files and existing backups are not deleted.
Chalisa Counter saves your daily recitation counts in private app storage on your device. The app does not use accounts, ads or analytics, and does not send your counts to the developer.

Depending on your Android backup settings and device, Android may back up your counts to cloud storage or transfer them to another device. Manage backups through your device settings. Backup storage and retention are managed by your backup provider.

An export is created only when you tap Export and choose where to save it. The text file contains your daily counts, total progress and export date. If you choose a cloud storage provider, that provider may upload and store the file under its own terms and privacy policy.

If your counts did not come across with your Android backup, tap Export on the old phone and send the file to yourself (for example by email, Drive or WhatsApp). On the new phone, save the file, tap Import and choose it. Days in the file take the count from the file, and days counted only on the new phone are kept. Before anything changes, you will see exactly what will be restored, kept and replaced. The file is read only on your phone and is not sent anywhere.

Counts stay in app storage until you reset them, clear app storage in Android settings or uninstall the app. Reset clears the counts in the app, but does not delete exported files or existing backups. Delete exported files from the location you chose and manage existing backups with your backup provider. Restoring a backup may restore earlier counts.
No browser is available. Open the privacy policy at https://mahajansamiksha.github.io/chalisa-counter-privacy-policy/
